verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. The normative RDF-star probe now requires only Quad-subject support, so conforming implementations that reject Quad objects still execute the subject-position equality, keying, and copy tests. Object-position quoting is independently feature-detected and consistently labelled as a non-normative extension in both source and README. The revised tests exercise the actual factory-produced terms and copies rather than mocks, and the directional-literal checks meaningfully cover datatype, equality, canonical-key discrimination, and fromTerm preservation. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue remains in the diff.
